decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "All Webinars are presented on Tuesdays/Thursdays" is an h4 with no h3 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 28 links on this page open a file — 15 Excel, 11 CSV, 2 Word — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: Webinars from previous years, as well as current year webinars that have been presented, can be found on the DOE Data Team's YouTube Channel

decisions.label: Let a column of short entries keep them on one line
decisions.why: 3 columns hold nothing longer than sixteen characters and sit in a table that also has a column of paragraphs. The layout sizes a column by its longest unbreakable run, so "Step 1" asks only for the width of "Step" and the paragraph column takes the rest — which is how "Step" and "1" end up on separate lines in a column with room to spare beside it. Held on one line, the column asks for what it needs. Nothing is widened by force and no word changes.

decisions.label: Let a long table be searched
decisions.why: 2 tables run to fifteen rows or more, so finding one row means reading every row. The theme already loads the search behaviour on every page and switches it on for any table marked this way — 26 tables across the site already are, including the contact directory. It adds a search box, a length menu and a pager, and makes the column headings sortable; ten rows show at a time, which is the library's own default. Nothing is reordered until someone asks.

decisions.label: Add a contents list (5 sections)
decisions.why: Built from the section headings already on the page. Below three sections a list is not a route.
